plugins.name: feasibility-cycle
plugins.description: Feasibility role cycle: takes a specification only (deliberately without the market argument), runs four sequential probes (technical, prior art, legal/regulatory, threat model), and gates entry into a verdict on all four being resolved. A UserPromptSubmit hook mints an approval token only from the user's own turn; a PreToolUse hook gates the state file's transitions against the token and the probe fields, evaluated on the target path regardless of which tool wrote it.

plugins.name: feasibility-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the feasibility role: installs feasibility-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.
